tagline_en: Speak with confidence about your work, your life, the news and the future.
tagline_ar: اتكلم إنجليزي بثقة عن شغلك وحياتك والأخبار والمستقبل.
intro_ar: المستوى ده لكل اللي خلّص المستوى الأول والتاني وعايز ينتقل من الجمل القصيرة للكلام الطبيعي والطويل. في ١٢ أسبوع هتتعلم ٣٦٠ كلمة وتعبير جديد و١٢٠ جملة مهمة، وهتقدر تحكي قصة، وتنقل كلام حد، وتقول رأيك، وتعدّي مقابلة شغل بالإنجليزي.
can_do: After this level you can talk about your job and your experience (I've been working here for…).
After this level you can tell a story or a news report using the right past tenses.
After this level you can make predictions, imagine situations and give advice (If I were you…).
After this level you can report what people said and asked, for example after a job interview.
After this level you can ask polite questions and solve problems when you travel.
After this level you can write a 120–150-word email, story or opinion paragraph with good linking words.

end.title: You Finished Level 3! What Next?
end.intro: Congratulations — in 12 weeks you learned 360 new words and phrases, 120 key sentences and the most important B1 grammar. You can now talk, write and tell stories with confidence. Keep your 30 minutes a day!
next_steps: Repeat the 120 sentences of this level once a week for the next month.
Listen to one new BBC 6 Minute English episode every day and write down five new words.
Move up to British Council B1 and then B2 listening and reading lessons.
Write one 150-word paragraph a week (an email, a story or your opinion) and read it aloud.
Take the level test again, compare it with your first score, then start Level 4.
end.tip_ar: لديك الآن أساس قوي — لا تتوقف! استمع إلى شيء بالإنجليزية كل يوم، وتحدّث ولو خمس دقائق، وراجع جمل هذا المستوى كل أسبوع؛ هكذا يخرج كلامك طبيعيًا دون تفكير طويل.
